description: Preserve the destination-bound release_mode in the placement intent. The interior/support plane remains its measured floor; it is never relabeled as the rim. Obtain the current destination support region and interpret only this transfer location clause. Use an accepted CAD interior-floor/surface definition or a measured support plane; do not demand visible depth for a registered CAD floor. Reuse an already confirmed destination relation when its binding is valid. Decide whether the language authorizes the entire region or adds a relative position/subregion/orientation constraint. Selecting a container on the left/right does not itself constrain a point within that container. CAD selection, grasp method, later processing, return posture and task completion are outside these questions. Unknown geometry or language returns an explicit reason; the graph chooses any legal recovery movement, observation and retry. Reuse a positive identify_destination intermediate permission only for the identical target, destination/reference, task, capture and region configuration. This permission does not certify final delivery. Ask separately about any additional within-region language constraint.
